function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time in New York right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can check your phone, computer, or a reliable world‑time website.  

Just a quick reminder: New York is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time, UTC‑5 otherwise). If you know the current UTC time, subtract 4 hours (or 5 hours) to get the local time.
